decisions.q: Should pyarrow be a required dependency or an optional extra?
decisions.explain: Parquet export needs pyarrow (~40 MB). The project has no pyarrow dependency today. Making it optional keeps installs small; CSV export works either way. Suggested: optional extra.

options.description: pip install demo-app[parquet]; clear error message if missing. (suggested)
